svg.title: Babul's medicine parcel is rejected beneath the newly braced billboard.
svg.desc: A second brace straightens the billboard while blocking the remaining half-lane. Babul holds a real medicine parcel beside a red dispatch rejection; Cecil reports that the landmark address is false as Riju turns from the celebration.
svg.text: Page 32, panel 5 · Street-level wide shot beneath the newly braced billboard

text.tspan: The system rejects Babul's next medicine delivery
because the landmark address now resolves to false.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
